title: 伯恩斯坦Stacy：循环融资好坏难断，新CEO会否延续供应链布局？
speaker: Stacey Rasgon

segments.en: Stacy, this is Steve Angle up in Shanghai. I want to jump in here and ask you again about some of those broader ramifications of this beyond, you know, the walls of Envidia into the industry as a whole, whether this has an
segments.zh: Stacy，我是上海的Steve Angle。我想插进来再问一下，除了英伟达本身，这对整个行业的更广泛影响，是否会对我们看到的AI交易重新定价产生影响。

segments.en: impact on what we had seen, the repricing of the AI trade.
segments.zh: 对AI交易重新定价的影响。

segments.en: But I want to ask a question to you that you ask in your report here for the supply chain itself, we wonder what will happen to the company's myriad of investments in the space.
segments.zh: 但我想问你一个你在报告里提到的问题，关于供应链本身，我们想知道该公司在该领域的大量**会怎样。

segments.en: We all know that he has, you know, cobbled together a lot of different suppliers and partners in the AI space.
segments.zh: 我们都知道，他在AI领域拼凑了许多不同的供应商和合作伙伴。

segments.en: What happens to all of that? Again, that's the, I, I don't know, right?
segments.zh: 所有这些会怎样？再说一次，我不知道。

segments.en: For now, presumably it'll stick around. Well, I guess the, whoever the new CEO is will have to make a determination of whether they, they want to continue that or not.
segments.zh: 目前来看，估计会维持下去。我想，无论新CEO是谁，都得决定是否继续这样做。

segments.en: I, I, I don't know. Maybe he could argue it's good.
segments.zh: 我不知道。也许他可以辩称这是好事。

segments.en: Like a lot of people worry about, they, they talk about circular financing and such and maybe it's good.
segments.zh: 就像很多人担心的那样，他们谈论循环融资之类的，也许这是好事。

segments.en: The same time, if it turns out they actually do need it, like that becomes a problem if you're not doing it any far.
segments.zh: 同时，如果事实证明他们确实需要它，而你不做任何长远打算，那就会成为问题。

segments.en: So I think that's TBD at this point. I don't know that we, we know what that's going to look like.
segments.zh: 所以我认为目前还待定。我不知道我们是否知道那会是什么样子。

segments.en: It's going to be a while.
